name: pol
description: Authoring support for Pol — an abstract language for modelling real-world domains as partial Ologs — over .pol models and .claims question files: diagnostics, outline, hover and completion, served by the language's own OCaml server.

pol.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `pol_lsp` language server executable. A relative path is resolved against each open workspace folder, so the default finds the server built by `make build` in a checkout of this repository. Set an absolute path to use a server built elsewhere.
